core_concept.description: A mobile fitness application that promotes a healthy lifestyle through gamified rivalry and competition. With features like Rival Mode, leaderboards, and point-based rankings, users are motivated to push themselves and engage with their fitness goals consistently
core_concept.target_audience: Fitness enthusiasts who thrive on competition and social accountability

goals_and_objectives: Promote healthy lifestyle through rivalry and competition
Drive user engagement through gamified fitness tracking
Create competitive social ecosystem for fitness motivation

routine_creation.title: Routine Creation
features: Create custom workout routines from ExerciseDB API
Save and share routines with other users

fitness_tracking.title: Fitness Tracking
features: Log workouts: duration, sets, reps, weight, distance
Manual step or distance input available

nutrition_tracking.title: Meal, Calorie & Nutrition Tracking
features: Search food via USDA FDC API
Log meals by category: Breakfast, Snack, Lunch, Dinner, MicroMeals
Track calories and macros (Protein, Carbs, Fat)
Set daily calorie and macro goals
Track remaining calories based on daily limit

leaderboard.title: Leaderboard
features: Daily, Weekly, Monthly, and All-Time leaderboards
Rankings based on weighted point system

rival_mode.title: Rival Mode
features: Compete 1v1 in solo or challenge mode
Winner earns 10% of rival's weekly points

competitions_challenges.title: Competitions/Challenges
features: In-app chat/comment area for each challenge

authentication.title: Signup/Login
features: Signup: First name, Last name, Email, Username, Password
Optional: Height, Weight, Goal Weight, Fitness Level

social_features.title: Add Friends
features: Search for and add friends by username or email

point_rank_system.title: Point & Rank System
features: Progression: E → D → C → B → A → S → SS
Points earned via workouts, steps, meals, PRs
Rival Mode wins (+10% of rival's points)
Weighted point system based on activity importance

penalty_system.title: Penalty System
features: Triggered by failing minimum workout requirements
Choose between point deduction or Extreme Routine
Extreme Routines curated by challenge creators

ui_ux_design.theme: Competitive and motivational with rivalry-focused design

success_metrics: Leaderboard Engagement: 50% of users in at least 1 challenge or rival pairing
mvp_scope: Meal and Nutrition Tracking with USDA API
Point & Rank System (E through SS ranks)
future_enhancements: Premium Mode with Analytics & Custom Coaching
Monthly Events/Seasons with exclusive Ranks or Rewards
Integration with wearables (Apple Watch, Fitbit, Garmin)

non_functional_requirements.security: Firebase Auth + Firestore rules + HTTPS API usage
non_functional_requirements.offline_support: Cached data entry with sync upon reconnect
non_functional_requirements.performance: Sub-second load time for major interactions
non_functional_requirements.accessibility: Dynamic text sizing and color contrast accessibility
